answer_1.quote: For machine translation (MT), special techniques can be utilized to seek erroneous instances, such as using a backward translator to check round-trip translations or quality estimation.

answer_2.quote: For disagreement-based strategies, the measurement of partial disagreement may be required, since full-match can be too strict for structured objects. Fine-grained evaluation scores can be reasonable choices for this purpose, such as F1 score for sequence labeling.
